name: Sacchan no Ie wa Fashion Health
original_name: さっちゃんの家はファッションヘルス
source:
The dark-haired otome's home is actual a brothel!?

Satsuki was beloved by her friends in archery club.
They were going to go to state championship, but one day
her parents simply up and vanished.

Her parents left a certain family business behind,
and Satsuki was named the inheritor and company director.
She was asked by the employees to take charge,
which she did between school and study.

Except the business... was not strictly legal...

This is the story of Satsuki, an earnest schoolgirl,
who becomes the proprietress of the family brothel
along with a veteran prostitute. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165582.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
黑发乙女的家居然是妓院！？

小月在射箭社深受朋友们的喜爱。
他们原本打算去参加州锦标赛，但是有一天
她的父母只是站起来就消失了。

她的父母留下了一定的家族生意，
小月被任命为继承人兼公司董事。
员工要求她负责，
她在上学和学习之间就这样做了。

除了生意……并不严格合法……

这是认真的女学生小月的故事，
谁成为家庭妓院的老板娘
和一位经验丰富的妓女一起。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165582.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
